environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) with no additional middleware. The Flask app listens directly on port 8080, ELB forwards TCP/443 to TCP/8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request inspection or filtering layer exists between the client and the application.

config.load_balancer: Classic ELB, TCP listener 443->8080, no HTTP-level inspection
